title: Money follows the fund
hook: Two stated cases: explore the asymmetry of assumed inflows and outflows.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the asymmetry of assumed inflows and outflows affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Remaining, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the asymmetry of assumed inflows and outflows in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy budget starts with 1000 and spends -20 per day for 5 days. What remains?
